name: dsh-float-chat
description: Pops the DSH side chat into a free-floating, always-on-top desktop window usable over any other application, with its own 悬浮窗 settings page (appearance light / dark / follow-DSH / follow-Windows, always-on-top, remembered geometry, default size, opacity, close-window-ends-the-thread, session title in the title bar, Esc to close) and a cache-and-log cleanup card. One package, three halves: host.js serves the page, the settings, the theme channel and the cache routes, and owns the window process; client.js adds the 浮窗 composer button and the 悬浮窗 settings page; window/ is the WinForms + WebView2 program that draws the frameless window.
